gloss: return gift; thank-you gift; reciprocal gift

definitions.gloss: return gift; thank-you gift; reciprocal gift
definitions.explanation: A gift given in return for a gift or favor received. Most commonly refers to the thank-you gifts sent by local governments to donors in the furusato nouzei (hometown tax) system.

examples.japanese: {返礼品|へんれいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼品|へんれいひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Wagyu beef arrived as a return gift from my hometown tax donation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧な{返礼品|へんれいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}っている→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
examples.english: Local governments are soliciting donations by offering attractive return gifts.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{返礼|へんれい}→返礼：16228_henrei⟧ (returning a courtesy, reciprocal gift) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, product). While the word can refer to any reciprocal gift, it has become strongly associated with Japan's ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧ (hometown tax donation) system.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧ system, taxpayers can donate to any local government in Japan and receive tax deductions plus {返礼品|へんれいひん} — often local specialty products like premium beef, seafood, rice, or fruit. This system has become enormously popular, and browsing {返礼品|へんれいひん} catalogs is a common year-end activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}→ふるさと納税：17628_furusatonouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼品|へんれいひん} — hometown tax return gift
- {返礼品|へんれいひん}⟦カタログ→カタログ：10806_katarogu⟧ — return gift catalog
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返礼品|へんれいひん} — popular return gifts
- {返礼品|へんれいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ — to receive a return gift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{返|かえ}し→お返し：08354_okaeshi⟧ — return gift (general, everyday term)
- ⟦{内祝|うちいわ}い→内祝い：16037_uchiiwai⟧ — celebratory return gift (given in return for congratulatory gifts)
- ⟦{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}→贈答品：20125_zoutouhin⟧ — gift item (broader, not specifically a return gift)
